blocks.text:
An oil painting made in London in 1785. A villa stands above a lake with an arched stone bridge and a ruined wall beside it, cattle on the far bank, and the light going out of a sky that still holds the last of it.

Abraham Pether was known for painting night and moonlight, enough that his contemporaries called him Moonlight Pether. This one is not a night scene, but it has the same quiet.

items: Yale Center for British Art, Paul Mellon Collection
Public domain: the artist's rights lapsed long ago
